card.name: Small words before body-part or recovery terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "for", "and" or "mid" that come just before a body-part or physiological term. Most often seen in descriptions of bowel disease extent and in steroid withdrawal and recovery.

modes.label: Bowel disease extent
modes.description: "the" or "entire" or "and" right before colon or rectum terms when describing how far disease spreads.
modes.example: Those who have disease in<< the>> entire colon (pancolitis) usually

modes.label: Timing or recovery phrases
modes.description: "for" or "mid" leading into a phase or recovery term.
modes.example: a number of months are required<< for>> recovery of hypothalamic-pituit

modes.label: Partway through a medical term
modes.description: A split-off piece inside a longer medical word.
modes.example: severe neuropathic pain,<< trans>>verse myelitis, and reversible posterior
